lessons.title: What is Psychology? Science vs. Pseudoscience
lessons.description: Understand the definition, primary goals of psychology, and how empirical science differs from pseudoscience.

lessons.title: Historical Roots: From Structuralism to Functionalism
lessons.description: Trace psychology from Wundt's first laboratory through Structuralism, Functionalism, and Gestalt theory.

lessons.title: Major Modern Psychological Perspectives
lessons.description: Compare psychodynamic, behavioral, cognitive, humanistic, biological, and biopsychosocial paradigms.

lessons.title: Research Methods & Ethics in Psychological Science
lessons.description: Master experiments, correlations, naturalistic observations, variables, and ethical principles like informed consent.
